protocol_name: V2-I1 unified entity belief graph integration
research_question: Can one bounded online entity-belief system jointly retain identity, infer self from action-conditioned motion, and preserve occluded distractors from one unlabeled visual-action stream?
scope_statement: This is a new implementation after the V1 development failure. It preserves every V1 metric threshold and the untouched one-shot holdout seeds, but replaces the two-tracker composition with one bounded global hypothesis bank. It does not revise or erase the V1 negative result.

amendment_record.reason: Three post-failure oracle diagnostics separated the bottlenecks. Perfect association raised identity consistency to 0.9691 but self F1 only to 0.6517, proving both association and hard self-locking were limiting. Truth visibility changed distractor hidden probability only from 0.2595 to 0.2641, proving the visibility-agnostic reachable-floor motion model was the permanence bottleneck. V2 therefore replaces the two independent trackers, hard self lock, and reachable-floor painting with one bounded multi-hypothesis entity belief graph and entity-conditioned occupancy posterior.

development.authorization_rule: Both the validation subset and the complete 16-seed development set must pass every fixed gate.

failure_policy.development_failure: Stop before holdout, diagnose by calibration/validation and mechanism-level traces, and amend before changing the formal algorithm.
failure_policy.holdout_failure: Record the one-shot failure and do not tune or rerun on the same holdout seeds.
